title: 2022 Panini Zenith Retail #17 Daniel Jones New York Giants Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2022 Panini Zenith sports trading card features Daniel Jones, the quarterback for the New York Giants in the National Football League (NFL). The card is part of the base set and has the card number 17. It also has a parallel/variety feature, which adds uniqueness to the card. 

The card is perfect for collectors who are fans of the NFL and specifically, fans of the New York Giants. It is a great addition to any sports trading card collection and is a must-have for fans of Daniel Jones. The card is manufactured by Panini and is part of the 2022 season.
